hitl_conditions: Not discussed explicitly; the ANN surrogate is designed so practitioners can run stress tests without modeling tools, and components are to be developed with continuous stakeholder feedback.
key_finding: Conceptual proposal (no implementation or results): a supply-chain digital twin combining a BOM/geospatial graph model, ML disruption prediction, an optimisation decision model and discrete-event simulation with a feedback loop; an ANN metamodel trained on the decision-simulation pair serves as surrogate so practitioners can stress-test without modeling tools.

quotes.text: The framework is based on a supply chain digital twin that will be formed with the industrial Internet of Things technology for accessing field data, machine learning models for disruption prediction, simulation methods for disruption scenario analysis
we propose a conceptual framework for diagnosing the vulnerability of suppliers, logistic providers, and commodities for any size of multi-tier supply chain networks for private and public bodies
The framework also exploits a deep learning-based surrogate model of the digital supply chain twin.

The developed combined decision and simulation model mechanism is used for training a metamodel (artificial neural network, ANN) which enables stakeholders to use the stress testing framework without needing decision and simulation modeling tools.

quotes.text: Several supply chain networks from academic literature will be used to generate test instances. Disruption scenarios will be generated based on these instances as well as a decision model to develop mitigation plans
